article.title: Klook分階段推出K.ai，讓商戶以指令更新價格與庫存
article.title_en: Klook rolls out K.ai in phases for merchant pricing and inventory tasks
article.summary: Klook於11月3日公布商戶後台代理，可查預訂資料並按指令執行更新。
article.summary_en: Klook’s November 3 announcement describes a merchant-portal agent that retrieves booking data and acts on instructions.
highlights: K.ai可查預訂與供應情況，並更新庫存及價格。
全球推出採分階段安排，產品上架資料可先預填再由商戶審閱。
highlights_en: K.ai can check bookings and availability and update inventory and pricing.
Rollout is phased; product-listing fields can be prefilled for merchant review.
article.why: 旅遊體驗商戶可把產品資料與營運更新連起來，減少促銷內容與實際供應不一致。
article.why_en: Experience merchants can connect product content with operational updates to reduce mismatches with availability.
article.next_step: 先確認帳戶是否開放，再測試一項可復原的庫存更新，核對變更紀錄。
article.next_step_en: Confirm account access, then test one reversible inventory update and check the change record.
article.detail: 這是面向Klook商戶後台的工具，並非旅客用來代訂行程的代理。按公告，它可由既有材料生成結構化產品上架資料，預填欄位供商戶修改，亦可整理評論及表現資料。公司公布部分早期效率與預訂量比較，未提供足以判斷因果的完整方法；本報不沿用成效比例。分階段推出亦代表各商戶取得功能的時間可能不同，重要價格變更仍宜覆核。
article.detail_en: This serves merchant operations, not traveler booking. It can draft structured listings for review and surface review/performance insights. Vendor efficiency and booking comparisons do not establish causation, so their ratios are omitted. Phased access and consequential price changes require checking.
